title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 18 October 2026
description: Fresh AI capital keeps flowing as Microsoft and Nvidia roll out new specialised systems, Australia's dry spring breaks with a major rain system forecast across the eastern states, Cairns secures hundreds of millions in state and federal funding, and the Gold Coast's first dedicated surf park at Parkwood moves toward construction. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
